newsitem.title: FINLAND: Orion to keep Prihti on board of dirs.
newsitem.headline: Orion to keep Prihti on board of dirs.

text.p: The supervisory board of Finnish pharmaceuticals group Orion Oy said in a statement on Monday its board of directors would remain unchanged from January 1, 1997 despite the resignation of president and CEO Aatto Prihti.
The supervisors said in a statement that Orion's board of directors would comprise chairman Asko Perisalo, vice-chairman Aatto Prihti, Erkki Etola, Juhani Leikola and Pauli Torkko.

The men and their positions were unchanged from the current situation. Orion said earlier Prihti would resign as president of the Orion Corporation and CEO of Orion group to join the Finnish National Fund for Research and Development (SITRA).
